inspiration.observed_pattern: A document-title repair pipeline uses CTEs to normalize source text, extracts title fragments from structured JSON with a correlated aggregate, filters placeholder labels, ranks candidates per session with ROW_NUMBER, and updates only sessions that still have blank titles.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a notebook session-title refresh. A temporary ranked relation combines markdown and JSON heading entries, JSON_TABLE expands heading text fragments for ordered GROUP_CONCAT reconstruction, ROW_NUMBER chooses the earliest valid title per session, and a correlated scalar UPDATE fills only blank active sessions while preserving an existing and an archived session. SQLite string/time expressions and the source schema, labels, rows, and migration workflow are not copied.

fixture_notes: Session 501 receives the first valid markdown title even though a later entry is also valid; session 502 reconstructs a JSON heading from two text fragments; session 503 keeps its existing title; archived session 504 remains unchanged; placeholder headings and deleted entries do not become candidates.
determinism_notes: Session IDs, entry order, timestamps, JSON fragments, ranking order, update marker, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE notebook_sessions (session_id INT PRIMARY KEY, session_title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, archived TINYINT NOT NULL, refresh_state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE notebook_entries (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, session_id INT NOT NULL, entry_order INT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, body_format VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, body_text TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_flag TINYINT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ranked_session_titles AS WITH normalized_entries AS (SELECT e.entry_id, e.session_id, e.entry_order, e.created_at, e.body_format, e.body_text, TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(e.body_text, CHAR(9), ' '), CHAR(10), ' '), CHAR(13), ' ')) AS normalized_body FROM notebook_entries AS e INNER JOIN notebook_sessions AS s ON s.session_id = e.session_id AND s.archived = 0 WHERE TRIM(s.session_title) = '' AND e.deleted_flag = 0), entry_titles AS (SELECT n.entry_id, n.session_id, n.entry_order, n.created_at, CASE WHEN n.body_format = 'markdown' AND LEFT(n.normalized_body, 2) = '# ' THEN SUBSTRING(n.normalized_body, 3) WHEN n.body_format = 'json' AND JSON_VALID(n.body_text) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(n.body_text, '$.content[0].type')) = 'heading' AND JSON_EXTRACT(n.body_text, '$.content[0].attrs.level') = 1 THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(jt.node_text ORDER BY jt.position SEPARATOR '') FROM JSON_TABLE(n.body_text, '$.content[0].content[*]' COLUMNS (position FOR ORDINALITY, node_type VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.type', node_text VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.text')) AS jt WHERE jt.node_type = 'text') ELSE '' END AS candidate_title FROM normalized_entries AS n), valid_titles AS (SELECT entry_id, session_id, entry_order, created_at, TRIM(candidate_title) AS title FROM entry_titles WHERE TRIM(candidate_title) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(candidate_title)) NOT IN ('summary', 'untitled', 'untitled note')), ranked_titles AS (SELECT session_id, title, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY entry_order, created_at, entry_id) AS title_rank FROM valid_titles) SELECT session_id, title, title_rank FROM ranked_titles

UPDATE notebook_sessions AS s SET s.session_title = (SELECT r.title FROM ranked_session_titles AS r WHERE r.session_id = s.session_id AND r.title_rank = 1), s.refresh_state = 'derived' WHERE TRIM(s.session_title) = '' AND s.archived = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranked_session_titles AS r WHERE r.session_id = s.session_id AND r.title_rank = 1)
SELECT session_id, session_title, archived, refresh_state FROM notebook_sessions ORDER BY session_id
